appfunction.description: Execute one complete Ostadix .O source document through the primary o_execute MCP tool on the local configured host. Use this for user-requested Ostadix computations combining supported runtimes or executing a lifted project. Pass complete source text, optional JSON bindings, and a lower timeout. Ostadix owns parsing, planning and execution. Returns the actual structured MCP result with disposition, result and evidence. Report failures precisely; do not automatically repeat a program that may already have produced effects. Example source: bash^(printf 42)_bash .

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: One complete UTF-8 .O source document. Do not pass a path, shell wrapper, OIR, HGraph, or Ostadix command line.

parameters.name: bindingsJson
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of typed input bindings. JSON null, booleans, signed 64-bit integers, finite numbers, strings, arrays, and objects map recursively to O values. Default is {}.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Optional execution deadline in milliseconds from 1 through 900000. Default is 120000.

response.description: Structured o_execute JSON result. Ordinary programs return result.typed_value and evidence; lifted projects return result.decoded_value and route evidence. Failures return disposition and failure with stage and message.
